en.bilal-muhammad: Ya`qub b. Yusuf b. Ya`qub narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. al-Khaytni informed us. He said: Ahmad b. Yahya al-Awdi narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Husayn al-`Urni narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Yusuf narrated to us from Sharik from Mansur from Rub`i from Hudhayfa.
He was asked about `Ali (as), so he said: That is the best of people; no one disputes that except a hypocrite.
